architect.description: Surveys all six repo-intel collectors once and defines the single shared shape for the four evidence labels (observed-fact / documented-intent / mechanical-inference / unknown-unresolved) before any collector code changes. Read-only.

implementer.description: Applies the architect's evidence-label spec to one collector file plus its own tests. Invoke once per collector: collect-files, collect-git, collect-config, collect-delivery, collect-planning, collect-product.

verifier.description: Runs the full suite and reviews each collector's diff against the architect's spec. Reports findings, does not patch them.

docs.description: Updates docs/README.md, root README.md, and a decision record once the evidence-label work has landed and passed verification.
